summary: Net security gain: the write-lockout hook can no longer silently disarm (every spawn-failure mode maps to blocking exit 2, pinned per mode); the cmd shim's executables-only allowlist eliminated a real argument-reparse injection class (call re-expansion of %* / PATHEXT chaining) found and closed during review; no user-global file writes; delegation lock gains msvcrt parity without weakening POSIX flock.

non_blocking_findings.summary: Hook-health certifies via sh -c; the real no-Git-Bash Windows executor (PowerShell/cmd) parses differently and doctor could falsely certify there (D-0019, fires at WIN-3 planning or first doctor-green-but-hooks-dead report).

residual_risks: Unsupported-executor lane (no Git Bash) relies on fail-closed outer guards rather than positive certification until WIN-3.
